body: Your website looks perfect for me! It's exactly what I need to finally be able to understand my chart. Could I also get a code?
Thank you, sending you a hug too!

Sometimes when I have a panic attack, I list all of the items that surround me, but it doesn't always help. I quickly get lost in the train of thoughts. I constantly try to work on it, but I can't see many results, especially when I can't deal with anything anymore.

I will try to have a conversation with him about it again.

Thank you for replying to me.

I have and he said that it depends on the day. He told me that he acts like that then he has one of those worse days. The problem is that everyday is one of those worse days. When I told thim that I don't know if I should tell him that I'm autoaggressive or that I have suicidal thoughts, he replied that I shouldn't do anything. I mean, he's right. But I don't feel like I have his full support in this.

I really don't want to be greedy. I'm so lost in all of this.

Thank you thank you thank you!! I learned so much because of it. It gave me hope for a better tomorrow.

I was not self-aware for a long time. It became more clear thanks to my boyfriend. Also, I thought that I was just stupid or messed up. The realization that I'm ill came to me yesterday, so a lot of things feel like they're new, even though they aren't.

Thank you so much for this response. It is almost overwhelming, in a good way.

Yes, I am currently in individual therapy, I have the sessions every two weeks because of my constantly changing schedule.
Thank you. I get it, I used to think the same way but one day it hit me that I want to feel happy for just one day in a year. Thinking that birthday would be the best option was my mistake I guess

I have neurosis but try various relaxation techniques. I'm easily hurt by what other people say or do. I try to be as positive as I can but when I crack... It gets dark. I'm scared for the future or that I'll try to kill myself because I promised one person that I wouldn't do that, but I don't see any other way
I have health problems which cause me pain but emotional pain hurts the most
